tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Free. Lists every resource Blockchain IQ sells per call over x402 (USDC on Base, or on Solana): id, path, price, what it returns and its parameters. Use the id with call_endpoint. Optional free_only=true keeps only resources that cost nothing.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Calls one catalogue resource with a plain GET. A free resource returns its data. A paid one returns the x402 payment requirements (HTTP 402: price, network, asset, payTo) and is NOT paid by this server, which holds no wallet. To buy: pay with your own x402 client, then call again with the signed pay
